instruction: When I compose a reply email, my response appears above the original message (top-posting). I prefer to have my replies below the quoted text (bottom-posting). Please configure Thunderbird to place my reply text below the original quoted message.

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing reply placement from top-posting (reply_on_top=1) to bottom-posting (reply_on_top=0). Evaluator checks if mail.identity.id1.reply_on_top is set to 0 (false). Uses existing check_thunderbird_prefs metric function.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly extracts Thunderbird prefs.js file from VM to verify configuration settings
Metric check_thunderbird_prefs correctly parses prefs.js and checks mail.identity.id1.reply_on_top preference value
Expected value of 0 semantically correct for bottom-posting (0=below, 1=above)
Postconfig appropriately closes Thunderbird before reading prefs.js to ensure preferences are flushed to disk
Complete instruction coverage: evaluator directly verifies the reply placement setting requested in instruction
Data flow is semantically correct: postconfig ensures state persistence -> getter extracts file -> metric validates preference value
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Evaluator assumes identity 'id1' exists. If Thunderbird profile uses different identity name, check would not detect the setting. However, this appears intentional for the pre-configured profile used in this task.

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_thunderbird_prefs first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
